header_sentences: See Medulla oblongata, and Spinal Marrow.

contexts.text: The interior memory is presented like a medullose substance, such as is in the human brain. HH 466.
Burnt-offerings of marrowy things () = the celestial things which are of love.
The correspondence of the medullae (of the brain). Treated of.
From these, fibres run forth, which constitute the medulla of the brain...
For the happiness penetrated to the medullary things.
For the sphere of their love passed through even to the medullary things.
Poison... which penetrates to the very marrows.
From these go forth fibres through the medullary substance... into the body.
(The brains) consist of... a cortical substance and a medullary substance... and the medullary substance (consists of) innumerable quasi fibres.
But the medullary or fibrillary substance everywhere begins and proceeds from (the cortical); and from it are the nerves, from which are all things of the body.
By the marrows are meant the interiors of the mind and the body.
Faith without truths is like seed bereaved of the medullary substance.
The other (substance of the brain) is fibrillary, and is called medullary... It consists of perpetual confasciculations of fibres which go forth from the glands of the (cortical) substance...
It injects its poisons into the marrows, as they say; that is, into the interiors of the ideas...

From these proceed fibrils... from which is produced the medullary substance of the whole cerebrum, of the cerebellum, and of the medulla oblongata. From this medullary substance are protended the visible fibres...
A feast of fat things, of marrowy fat things () = good both natural and spiritual with joy of heart.

2. The will and the understanding are within the substances which make the cortex of the brain, and also sparsely in the medullary substance of the cerebrum, especially in the corpora striata, and also within the medullary substance of the cerebellum, and also in the spinal marrow, of which they make the nucleus...
